usage: A 'return ticket' refers to a ticket that allows you to travel to a destination and come back using the same ticket.
You can buy a 'return ticket' at the station or online for convenience.
When using a 'return ticket', make sure to check the validity period so you don't miss your return journey.
'Return ticket' is often cheaper than buying two separate one-way tickets.
In conversation, 'return ticket' usually refers to a round trip within a limited timeframe.
